reviews.t: Too soft to be useful
reviews.x: Not "medium firmness" at all. The bristles are too soft to get through most people's hair, unless you want to just smooth over flyaways on the surface. My hair is EXTREMELY fine and thin, yet this brush is still nearly useless. My other boar bristle brushes (e.g., Mason Pearson) have much firmer bristles, to actually brush the hair. I would not buy this again, but I didn't return because it wasn't worth the trouble. Might work for a baby's short, fine hair, or a man's short beard.

reviews.t: Bristles missing, works okay on super fine bangs
reviews.x: This brush is the perfect size for your purse but it isn't very good quality. When it arrived the first  thing I noticed was that one of the holes was empty where bristles are supposed to be. Not to mention there  were two sticker labels on the brush that left a sticky residue when I removed them, on the wood handle and back of the brush. I may use it from time to time if I remember to throw it in my purse as a quick bang brush. The bristles are very soft and don't work to brush out my hair anyw

reviews.t: Don't Buy This Brush
reviews.x: Don't waste your money!  This is terrible quality.  It is travel size, but the brush part is smaller than my nail brush.  The bristles started falling out as I removed it from the plastic bag.  It may be boars hair, but it doesn't resemble any of my other boar hair brushes.  The brisles are very stiff and shiny black.  The company does not take returns, so I am stuck with a terrible purchase!  Very Disappointed!!!!

reviews.t: Good little brush
reviews.x: I bought this brush for my purse. It is very small which is great because I carry a small purse. At first I didn't like it. It didn't appear to go all the way through my hair. I learned not to push hard while brushing and to brush pieces of my hair at a time and then doing the roots. It does make your hair shiny and smooth. If you are looking for a small hairbrush that is not a wire brush, this is a good one. I would recommend buying this brush.

reviews.t: Completely useless.
reviews.x: Advertised as "medium firmness" but in reality it is extremely soft; so soft that it is useless even on very thin/fine hair.  Worse yet, even though the item is fulfilled through Amazon, they will not accept any returns.  May as well just burn your money rather than buying this useless product.

reviews.t: GOOD QUALITY HAIR BRUSH
reviews.x: This is a good quality brush.  My hair is very thin and I was looking for a suitable soft brush.  The dealer's description was accurate.  But from the feedback other buyers gave, I thought that it was softer than the brush I received.  So, maybe I was reading something into their feedback. Anyway, its a well made brush, softer than most and I am happy with it.

reviews.t: It is definirely a poor value. Ill be seeking a refund for sure
reviews.x: This brush is ridiculously small! It's barely big enough for a baby. It is definirely a poor value. Ill be seeking a refund for sure.

reviews.t: Small gentle bristles
reviews.x: Is a small little brush and the bristles are very soft. It works quite well for a child's hair but for mine is not really stiff enough to get into the hair. It works pretty well for me for doing the ends both in the front and the back while I'm blow-drying it but I need a stiffer brush to blow dry at the midsection of my hair. It would be great for people with  a sensitive Scalp for sure. I think the product seems well made. I purchased this product at a reduced price in return for an honest rev

reviews.t: Not even worth the cheap price
reviews.x: I have fine hair, but a lot of it. I bought this brush hoping to carry it in my purse or put it in my desk at work because throughout the day my hair gets tangled and looks stringy if not kept brushed. I'd been reading up on boar bristle brushes and how they are great for fine, oily hair. Well this thing was terrible, yes it is small which is what I wanted, BUT the bristles are so soft that I can't get it through my hair at all. Even when I section it into small pieces! I can't imagine this doin

reviews.t: Great Portable Beard Brush
reviews.x: I bought this brush for my beard. I wanted to experiment with a boars hair brush vs Kent comb and wood comb. In short, I'd say if you're looking for a boars hair brush, this is a good one. I would definitely describe it as a portable medium stiffness brush. Boars hair brushes are great for helping orient hairs in specific directions when you're either growing out or styling your beard. The first time I used this on my cheek line, I was surprised by how well the skin beneath was exfoliated. Reall

reviews.t: if you have a great beard this would be a great brush you too
reviews.x: I bought this brush for my toddler, 15 months old. He loves to get his hair brushed, and brush his and anyone's hair that is willing. It has been a huge success for him. It is a small brush, in case you missed it in the description.  I must add, if you have a great beard this would be a great brush you too.  Great for babies and beards. or babies with beards haha  :)

reviews.t: I threw it away - just glides on top of hair
reviews.x: This does not penetrate my hair, just glided on top. I don't even have thick hair or a lot of hair. It's pretty fine and medium thickness and straight. Even if I held my hair taught it wouldn't penetrate. I threw it away because I didn't try to use it til after a month was up - it went it my travel kit. I was never able to get the stickiness of the label off either.

reviews.t: The Boar brush u can take EVERY WHERE
reviews.x: So convieniant to bring in a small bag . I selected the 3 different shapes An sizes An there ALL BOAR  so for me I prefer Boar my grandmother used a brush like this an anything made back in the day is not plastic cheaply made items - U get what u pay for except this case No big expense but a Great size

reviews.t: Great compact brush
reviews.x: Great compact brush. Bristles are a little on the soft side, but not too soft. Photos show it in on top of the packaging and next to a giftcard for size comparison.

reviews.t: Five stare ++
reviews.x: I really like this brush. It is made of 100% natural boar bristle and really good natural wood handle. It is soft yet firm. I completely changed my hair and skincare regime lately and this is a perfect addition to reduce my frizz. This is my first boar bristle brush and it leaves a nice shine, smoothness and volume. It is perfect to carry in my purse.  It appears to be durable.  It doesn't hurt or snag my long hair. I'm completely happy with this brush. I think it’s a great value and while I nev

reviews.t: Perfect Travel-Size Brush
reviews.x: I bought this as a travel-size hair brush, because it's very similar to my favorite regular-size bristle brush.  It's small, but it seems like it can comb through any hair that's not unusually thick or curly. The bristles are on the soft side and are good for gently untangling hair. This type of brush is very versatile, and would also be perfect for brushing a child's hair, or even a small animal! I really like the solid wood handle on the comb; it's well made and seems quite durable.

reviews.t: Best for beards...
reviews.x: SOoo... lots of complaints about size- it's small, travel size (read the description folks). It's probably not optimal for someone with thick or long hair. IT'S PERFECT, for my beard!! It's soft & does not dig into my skin yet manages to make my unruly beard obey my commands. Yes a few bristles fall out, about typical for any brush. So if you have a beard & want an easy soft brush to tame your whiskers this is your boy.

reviews.t: Short, soft bristles flatten in all but the thinnest hair
reviews.x: I bought this to travel with, but its completely worthless as a hairbrush. Bristles are too soft and flatten when I try to run it through my hair. Unless the listing has been updated since I wrote this, the product pictures are not an accurate depiction of what you get. Standard size lip balm in my pictures for scale.

reviews.t: Be aware that bristles are very soft.
reviews.x: I purchased because my wife wanted REAL brush (and it is high quality) but her complaint is that bristles are actually TOO SOFT to brush her hair.  The older boar bristle brushes are stiffer. Most on the market are junk plastic. This is a nice brush, just not usable for person needing it.

reviews.t: This brush is TINY and you can't return it.
reviews.x: On the packaging it says "Travel Size" "Brush for Pocket", but this is poorly advertised on the Amazon website. Also you can't return it since it's a brush and not packaged in a way that would allow them to resell/confirm it hasn't been used.

reviews.t: These are newborn baby brushes being passed off as purse-size ...
reviews.x: These are newborn baby brushes being passed off as purse-size styling brushes, Unusable by an adult woman even with very thin hair.  Will be returning them for sure.

reviews.t: Very tiny short bristle hair brush too stiff for a newborns hair and too tiny for adult or child
reviews.x: Not representative of the picture at all the Picture made it look MUCH larger than it actually is. The picture looks like a regular purse size brush. It's a very tiny brush that is not even big enough for my hair...The natural bristles seem ok quality, but they are far shorter and far too stiff for a newborn and brush is far too tiny bristles for an adult's or a child's hair. Very unhappy with the brush. It might be ok for a mustache but not for someone's head hair at all unless they have a crew

reviews.t: Wood has a coating that becomes sticky and gooey and rubs off.
reviews.x: The brush is a good size for purse and has nice bristles, good for smoothing fly always. The first time I tried to really clean the brush with water some kind of coating or stain on the wood came  off. It got very sticky and gross so I ended up just scraping it all off, it took some time but underneath was clean smooth wood. My pic is after the cleaning, I didn’t think to take a pic of before. I don’t use any hair products other than shampoo so this could not have been from anything I put on the

reviews.t: Too tiny and the bristles are very soft. I've ...
reviews.x: Too tiny and the bristles are very soft. I've spent more time plucking out soft bristles that have fallen out of this brush in my hair than I have actually brushing my hair. They also put a sticker right next to the bristles and I had to spend a considerable amount of time trying to clean that off so I could use the brush without getting my hair caught by the sticker goop.  Definitely an okay brush for children, dogs, and people with a small amount of hair. If you have thick hair at all, this wi

reviews.t: Great Toddler Hairbrush
reviews.x: I got this for my toddler. I was tired of the child hair brushes that don't move the hair very well.  I have an adult boar hair brush that works great but is too large.  This is just the right size.  This has stiff bristles that "penetrate" the hair and actually move it where you want it.  It straightens the hair and even creates a nice comb-over for a parted hair look, without nearly as many strokes with the brush compared to most child brushes.  It's made of a nice, mature looking, wood too.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bristles too soft to penetrate hair, even fine or thin hair, making the brush ineffective for actual brushing.
Reviewers frequently note the brush is very small, which some appreciate for purse or travel use but others find too tiny and a poor value.
Several reviewers report poor quality, including bristles falling out or missing holes on arrival.
Some reviewers praise it as a good quality brush that works well for beards, toddlers, and adding shine or reducing frizz.
A few reviewers mention return or refund difficulties and consider it a waste of money.

qa.q: Is it small enough to fit in my pocket or purse?
qa.answer: Yes, reviews say it is very small and fits in a purse or small bag [2][5]. One reviewer notes the packaging calls it a "Travel Size" "Brush for Pocket" [1].

claims.text: It is very small and fits in a small purse or bag.
The packaging labels it "Travel Size" and "Brush for Pocket."

qa.q: Will the bristles be too stiff or scratch my scalp?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: most say the bristles are very soft and not stiff [1][2][3][4][5], with one noting it would suit a sensitive scalp [4], but one reviewer found the bristles very stiff [6].

claims.text: Most reviewers describe the bristles as very soft and not stiff.
One reviewer says it would be great for people with a sensitive scalp.
One reviewer reports the bristles are very stiff.

qa.q: Does it work well for beards too?
qa.answer: Yes, several reviewers say it works well for beards, describing it as soft yet able to tame whiskers and good for orienting beard hairs [1][2][3]. However, one reviewer found the bristles too soft to be useful [4], so opinions on firmness differ.

claims.text: Reviewers say it is perfect for beards, soft yet able to make an unruly beard obey [1].
One reviewer says it would be a great brush for a great beard [2].
A reviewer describes it as a good portable medium stiffness boar bristle brush for styling a beard [3].
One reviewer found the bristles too soft to be useful [4].

qa.q: How durable is it for travel?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on durability: one reviewer reported bristles falling out immediately upon removing it from the bag [2], while another called it a well-made brush [5]. No review directly describes long-term durability for travel use.
